fix(dashboard): localize metrics chart accessible names and empty-range copy (w4/297)

Chinese Metrics charts kept English accessible names and the English
"No data in range" text. Chart names, per-bar labels and the default
empty message are now translated (English also gets correct singular).

Board: parked in blocked/ pending deploy + live replay.
